title: Hold a PS5's vertical stand square while hand-turning its screw snug, then roll the 2.6 kg console up onto it
instruction: Fit the stand to the PS5: hold it square while you turn its screw snug by hand, then roll the console upright onto it and let go.
context: More than 100 million PS5 consoles have been sold and PlayStation counts 127 million monthly active users (Sony Interactive Entertainment business data, 10 Nov 2026 and 30 Sep 2026). Sony's support page gives every owner who wants the console upright the same steps: lay it on a soft cloth, fit the vertical stand over its screw hole and secure the mounting screw by hand. The stand turns with its screw until the screw is snug, so one hand holds it square while the other turns; the 2.6 kg console is then rolled up onto the stand, more than one arm's 1.5 kg payload.
setup: A Sony PS5 Slim Digital Edition (CFI-2000, 358 x 80 x 216 mm, 2.6 kg) lies flat on a soft cloth on a media unit, its rear edge toward the arms and 60 mm proud of the unit's front, its stand end 5 mm past the unit's side. Sony's Vertical Stand (190 mm ring, 42 mm tall) sits square on that end on its started mounting screw (screw cap already removed).
scoring: 1/3: screw seated (3 turns through its seating torque; real trial: no further turn at the measured seating torque, bound 0.15 to 0.35 N m), stand marks within 5 degrees (whole turn counted). 2/3: also console within 10 degrees of upright. 1.0: also on its ring on the cloth within 5 degrees, at rest, grippers 30 mm clear, last 3 s. Void (0): console or ring falls faster than 0.35 m/s, its centre drops 20 mm below the unit top, or it tips past 45 degrees after standing.
reset_notes: The console back flat on the cloth in its start pose; the stand square on its end with the screw backed out to started (three turns from snug).
fidelity: Console and stand at Sony's sizes and mass. The screw is a hinge with speed-independent friction: 0.15 N m running, rising to 0.25 N m to seat over the last quarter turn (bounds 0.05 to 0.2 and 0.15 to 0.35 N m; torque screwdriver); half drags the stand round. Seated after 3 turns (3 to 5). Ring 4 mm wide (photo 3.5 to 5), grip 35 N. Head 18 mm across, 6 mm proud (5 to 8; calipers; under 5 is out of range). Frictions estimated, tilt test; demo 1.0 at the bounds. Rigid cloth.
scores: Demo: 1.0 (step 1142, 57.1 s); 1.0 at the bounds: 0.35 N m seating, 0.2 N m running, 5 turns, cloth 0.4 (contact 0.5), 5 mm head, 6 mm thick ring. Lazy: screw not turned 0, stand unheld 0, 0.4 turn short 0, console left flat 1/3, one hand 1/3, dropped 0. Dream-1: 0 (arms idle, 2400 steps).
